title: Hoshino Ichika — An Umbrella Waiting For Clear Skies〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: An Umbrella Waiting For Clear Skies（2★）

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I can focus on band practice now that my class representative duties are out of the way.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And thanks to Saki, our original song is actually starting to take on a real shape.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to try writing the song, if that's okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: While Saki was playing this song for us just now, I wondered what it would be like if it were given lyrics to go along with it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'd like to give it a try.
I want to come up with lyrics that match our song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Honami and Saki have work today too, so I can spend some time thinking about that while I practice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're finished with your meeting already?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Have you just been practicing on your own?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't want to disturb her by encroaching like this. Maybe I should try a different classroom...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, you know, for the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When you asked me to invite Saki to have lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You did that because you know I was worried about Saki, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. I know I might've sounded a bit overbearing but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I don't think so at all. Saki and I were able to have a nice chat because of that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, I should be thanking you too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm in the same class as her and feel like I should be the one to first notice if anything is wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But when push comes to shove, sometimes I don't have the confidence to be as open as I need to be with her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I find myself putting how she feels first before what I should be doing. As a result, I might've made her work harder than she needed to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you're always willing to put your foot down, Shiho. You know when to say, Stop.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because I know, I ended up having to lean on you this time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At the same time, I had this feeling that it needed to come from you more than anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So I'm beyond glad that you were able to talk to her about overworking herself and not having to try so hard...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm just as glad as you are.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was worried that I'd be saying too much and that I'd need you or Honami to put some fires out because I went too far...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When we were little, every time Saki and I fought, you two were there to make things better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was able to talk to Saki because you and Honami were willing to listen. You two were the ones that gave me that opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad I was able to help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You helped a lot.
More than you can imagine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I already told Honami this, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll be relying on you a lot more from now on.
